تنتقشوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِشُوا (tantaqišū) /tan.ta.qi.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# تُنْتَقَشُوا (tuntaqašū) /tun.ta.qa.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
